name: News ticker
description: Headlines as a rotating feature plus a smooth scrolling ticker. Type them in, or connect an RSS feed, Google Sheet, CSV or table. Full screen it shows both; in a thin strip it becomes a ticker bar, and in a tall zone a vertical side ticker. Nothing is fetched by the screen, so it works offline.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: feed
params.label: Headlines data source (optional)
params.help: An RSS/Atom feed, Google Sheet, CSV or table. When it has headlines they replace the typed list; until then the typed list is shown.

params.name: column
params.label: Headline column (Sheet, CSV or table)
params.help: The header of the column that holds the headlines. If no column has this name, the first column is used. Ignored for RSS feeds.

params.name: headlines
params.label: Headlines (used without a data source)
params.help: One headline per line. Blank lines are ignored. Also shown while a connected data source is empty.
params.default:
Northwind opens its new riverside studio on 6 October
Quarterly town hall moves to the main atrium — doors at 16:30
Congratulations to the support team: 98% satisfaction this quarter
The east car park is closed for resurfacing until Friday
New bike shelter now open behind building B, with charging for e-bikes
Lunch & learn on Thursday: accessibility in everyday design

params.name: max_items
params.label: Show at most
params.help: Headlines beyond this number are not shown.

params.name: speed
params.label: Ticker speed
params.help: Pixels per second on a 1080-pixel-high screen. Scales with the screen.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Clock timezone
params.help: Leave empty to use the screen's own clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: Language of the date and of the built-in words, for example de or en-GB. Leave empty for the screen's language.
